title: Cloud Build: triggers, steps, substitutions and build cache

videos.script: The deploy worked. That is where this course begins. {{deploy}} After the deploy comes everything else. A pipeline that ships the next change. A metric that says the shop is slow before a customer does. A key nobody should read, and a bill at the end of the month. {{course}} You will practise it on your own computer. There is no Google Cloud account in this course, and nothing is billed. {{laptop}} Here is the honest part. Nothing on a laptop answers like Google Cloud. Google publishes emulators for a few services, and that is all. So some of this course runs for real, and some is read from the documentation. Every lesson tells you which. {{honest}} This first lesson builds the lab, then looks at Cloud Build. A build is a list of containers. They share one directory, and an exit code decides whether the next one runs. {{steps}} By the end, you can read a build file step by step. You will know what starts a build, what a substitution is, and why the second build on a laptop is faster than the first one in the cloud. {{end}}
